scope: GTK2 native GtkProgressBar, four KDE color schemes, normal/disabled/backdrop states, coupled/separate previews; local Motif comparison only

historical_reference.motif_class: XmScale, disabled and read-only; Motif has no standard ProgressBar class
historical_reference.comparison: shared semantic roles and relief can be compared; slider geometry/value placement are not equivalent to a progress fill

implementation.change: GTK2 preview now places the sample percentage above a native GtkProgressBar, matching the Motif sample's value placement. Value text maps to the current KDE View foreground role for normal/backdrop/disabled states; runtime capture and restore still operate on GtkProgressBar.
implementation.color_policy: generated from current KDE View/Selection roles; no final static RGB values

checked: fill and track KDE role pixels
value text follows KDE View foreground in all four schemes/states
verification.visual_review: GTK2 keeps its native filled ProgressBar, but now places the sample percentage above it as Motif does for XmScale. The Motif reference has a slider thumb while GtkProgressBar has a fill segment; this structural mismatch remains and is not represented as pixel-equivalence.
verification.environment_note: GTK emitted an ATK bridge module warning in Xvfb; all 24 scenes completed and assertions passed.

limitations: The Motif sample is the Theme Lab reference, not the Domain/OS SR10.4 VM.
GTK2 fill/text and Motif slider are different native control semantics; only shared color roles and relief are directly comparable.
This does not approve the complete GTK2 family, public theme route, or personal/XChat installation.
next: Continue the remaining GTK2 control kinds under I167, one family at a time; keep historical VM claims open until the MAME channel has a correlated response.
